messages:
eva (partnerships): Partner check: Datadog + ApexEdge joint announcement demo on Thu 9am PT. Need a short obs "go/no-go" checklist (5-7 items) we can run 10m before the demo. Keep it very runnable.

mike (eng-sre): 1) OTLP endpoint & demo API key validated in demo env. 2) Datadog sampling rule exists: default 0.5% + override service:redwood-demo -> 100% for capture window.

anu (eng-runtime): 3) Runtime spans include model.name, model.revision, batch.size, cache.hit. Also GPU tags: gpu_id, gpu_mem_mb. Will add if missing.

frank (obs-liaison): 4) Dashboard import: latency (P50/P95) by model, tokens/sec, trace error list. I have a tiny JSON that imports in <30s.

mike (eng-sre): 5) Link logs <-> traces: X-Request-Id propagation verified end-to-end (client -> proxy -> runtime -> logs). Smoke command:

curl -X POST https://demo.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-Id: demo-$(date +%s)" -d '{"model":"mini","input":"ping"}'

Confirm that request-id appears in Datadog trace and in logs.

anu (eng-runtime): I'll add a short admin toggle: POST /admin/tracing {"rate":1.0} protected by header X-Admin-Token. Use it to flip to 100% capture for 60s.

frank (obs-liaison): 6) Alerts: mute production alerts for the demo window and create a demo-only trace alert: error_rate > 1% over 5m (notify demo channel only).

dd-bot: Datadog note: OTLP ingest available for the demo org. For short-lived API keys DM @dd-partner-success. Recommend pre-creating a trace-based SLO tile if you want to show SLA.

mike (eng-sre): I will run the pre-demo at Mon 3pm PT and post the short pass/fail checklist here: endpoints, sampling, log-linking, dashboard import, admin toggle.

eva (partnerships): Owners: @mike sampling/logs, @anu runtime attrs + admin toggle, @frank dashboard + mute alerts. Thanks team 680 Keep it tight.
